name: Shri Neeraj Dangi
education: B.E. (Civil) Educated at Karnataka Regional Engineering College, Surathkal, Karnataka
profession: Engineer, Political and Social Worker and Trader
permanent_address: F-263, Shyam Nagar Vistar, Jaipur, Rajasthan
social_activities: Worked to support the Tsunami victims' families and post Tsunami relief work at Andaman and Nicobar Islands, 9-22 February, 2005; the relief work was monitored by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
hobbies: Driving, travelling and sight seeing, photography, watching wildlife, exploring new places, playing various games
countries_visited: U.S.A., Venezuela, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Nepal, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Hong Kong, Macau, Australia, Brazil and Uruguay
other_information: Contested assembly election from Desuri Constituency, Rajasthan as I.N.C. candidate in 2003; contested assembly election from Reodar Constituency, Rajasthan as I.N.C. candidate in 2008 and 2018; President, Rajasthan Pradesh Youth Congress, 2004 - 2009; Member, (i) A.I.C.C., 2004-2010 and since 2018, (ii) Advisory Committee, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Studies Centre, (iii) Congress Screening Committee for Meghalaya Assembly elections-2023 (Dec. 2022), (iv) Congress Screening Committee for Karnataka Assembly elections - 2023 and (v) Congress Screening Committee for Lok Sabha elections 2024 for Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Chandigarh, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh; Spokesperson, Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee, 2011-2014; General Secretary, Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee, 2011-2020; Chairman, Communication Department, R.P.C.C., 2013-2014; as a representative of the youth of Rajasthan, participated in ‘The World Youth Conference’ held at Caracus (Venezuela), 2005; Convenor, (i) Congress Protocol Committee for Rajasthan Assembly elections, 2018 and (ii) Congress Coordination Committee for Rajasthan Assembly elections 2023; Pradesh Returning Officer (PRO), Odisha State for Congress Organisational election 2022
